title: Tautulli
descript: Tautulli is a monitoring and statistics companion for Plex Media Server. It records play history, shows live streams, bandwidth and library statistics, and can send notifications for new plays. This package runs the official LinuxServer.io Tautulli image as a non-root container; its database, configuration and cache live in the application data folder. Tautulli needs an existing Plex server: open the app, complete the setup wizard with the Plex URL and token, and the dashboard starts collecting data.
important: Requires DockerEngine and Plex; Tautulli shows no statistics until connected. First login: admin / tautulli - change it immediately, then complete the setup wizard with your Plex URL and token. Data stays on your NAS in DockerAppData/tautullidocker; the package sends no telemetry. A normal uninstall keeps the folder for reinstall; uninstall with data removal deletes it. Plain HTTP on the LAN; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it. Privacy policy: see the Help link.
release_note: 2.19.1-1: upgraded to Tautulli 2.19.1 (LinuxServer.io build v2.19.1-ls252); first-run wrapper seeds a known admin account (admin / tautulli, change immediately) so the login page is usable without container logs; added privacy policy; clarified Plex requirement and uninstall/data behaviour. Rectified per review comments.

data_notes: All persistent data stays on the NAS in `config` (`config.ini`, `tautulli.db`, cache). No telemetry is sent. Copying the folder is a complete backup; uninstall with data removal deletes it.
design_notes: **Non-root container.** The service runs as uid 1000 (verified on hardware), with no privileged mode, host network, Docker socket or `cap_add`. The upstream s6 init needs to adjust `/run` permissions, so `no-new-privileges`/`cap_drop` would break it; the non-root `user:` directive is the effective privilege reduction.

**Usable first login.** Tautulli 2.19 generates a random admin password on first start and prints it only in `/config/logs/tautulli.log`. `src/entrypoint.sh` seeds a known initial account (`admin` / `tautulli`, change immediately) into `/config/config.ini` before exec'ing the upstream `/init`; later starts keep the user's config untouched.
**One volume.** The database, settings and cache are all below `/config`; no other host path is written.

**Privacy.** The package sends no telemetry; the only outbound connection is the Plex server you configure (plus Tautulli's optional upstream update check). `PRIVACY.md` documents this and is linked from the package Help field.
**Health check** probes the web UI on container port 8181 (it answers with a redirect to the login page).
**Fixed image tag, never `:latest`**, Docker Hub only, no `privileged`, no `network_mode: host`, no Docker socket, no `cap_add`.
limitations: Tautulli is a companion for an existing Plex Media Server; without Plex it only provides the setup wizard and no statistics.
The page is plain HTTP on the LAN; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
Uninstalling without data removal keeps `/Volume1/DockerAppData/tautullidocker` so a reinstall can reuse the history and settings; choose data removal in the App Center to delete it.
Docker applications cannot be upgraded in place in the App Center: updating means uninstalling and reinstalling, which keeps the data folder.
